color.note: Web light and dark (c-*, from app/globals.css) are the base themes. Other channels are namespaced: brand-*, fin-*, app-*, apply-*, site-*. Single-value tokens are light only.

tokens.name: c-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm paper in light, warm black in dark. Body copy and every c-text-* tier sit on it. Canvas under the hairline card grids.

tokens.name: c-bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section band (Pricing, JobThreads, PlatformWorkflow). Use c-text, c-text-2/3 and c-text-mut on it; c-text-faint misses AA on it in light, so use c-text-mut for eyebrows here.

tokens.name: c-surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground: form fields and the waitlist card. Same text tiers as c-bg.

tokens.name: c-border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline: gap-px card grids, row dividers, FAQ rules, the source's field borders. Decorative only, about 1.2:1 against its grounds; never the only cue that a control exists (use c-border-control).

tokens.name: c-border-soft
tokens.usage: Softest hairline: sticky-nav bottom border and section separators. Decorative.

tokens.name: c-border-mid
tokens.usage: Outline of the secondary button (nav Join) and tool pills; hover goes to c-text. The label carries the meaning, the outline is decoration.

tokens.name: c-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on c-bg, c-bg-alt and c-surface. Off-black and off-white, never pure. Measured contrast (light: c-bg 17.66, c-bg-alt 16.63, c-surface 18.60; dark: c-bg 15.31, c-bg-alt 14.63, c-surface 14.21).

tokens.name: c-text-2
tokens.usage: Second tier: select values and thread status labels on c-bg, c-bg-alt and c-surface. Measured contrast (light: c-bg 13.98, c-bg-alt 13.17, c-surface 14.72; dark: c-bg 13.30, c-bg-alt 12.71, c-surface 12.35).

tokens.name: c-text-3
tokens.usage: Body copy and ledes on c-bg, c-bg-alt and c-surface. Measured contrast (light: c-bg 10.29, c-bg-alt 9.69, c-surface 10.83; dark: c-bg 10.42, c-bg-alt 9.95, c-surface 9.67).

tokens.name: c-text-mut
tokens.usage: Muted text: nav links, feature descriptions, list items, footer copy, on c-bg, c-bg-alt and c-surface. Measured contrast (light: c-bg 5.35, c-bg-alt 5.03, c-surface 5.63; dark: c-bg 6.18, c-bg-alt 5.91, c-surface 5.74).

tokens.name: c-text-faint
tokens.usage: Faintest text: eyebrows, step numbers, placeholders, arrow glyphs. Use on c-bg and c-surface only. On c-bg-alt in light it is 4.39:1 and misses AA (source pair kept exact): use c-text-mut there. Measured contrast (light: c-bg 4.67, c-surface 4.91, c-bg-alt 4.39; dark: c-bg 5.20, c-surface 4.83, c-bg-alt 4.97).

tokens.name: c-accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary button fill, links and highlighted tier badge. As text it reads on c-bg, c-bg-alt and c-surface; as a fill it takes c-on-accent. Measured contrast (light: c-bg 4.91, c-bg-alt 4.62, c-surface 5.17; dark: c-bg 6.31, c-bg-alt 6.03, c-surface 5.86).

tokens.name: c-accent-dark
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the primary button and hover text for accent links. Darker in light, lighter in dark. Measured contrast (light: c-bg 8.28; dark: c-bg 7.87).

tokens.name: c-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on c-accent and c-accent-dark fills. Not literal white: it flips to near-black in dark. Measured contrast (light: c-accent 5.17, c-accent-dark 8.72; dark: c-accent 6.33, c-accent-dark 7.89).

tokens.name: c-mark
tokens.usage: Text-selection highlight (::selection). Pair with c-on-mark.

tokens.name: c-on-mark
tokens.usage: Selected text over c-mark.

tokens.name: c-panel
tokens.usage: Dark inset panel: hero flow panel and the Estimations band. Stays dark in both themes, so in dark it is nearly the page colour (1.0:1 to c-bg); separate it with c-panel-border, not shade.

tokens.name: c-panel-2
tokens.usage: Deeper dark: WhyFree band and the inner card in Estimations.

tokens.name: c-panel-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on c-panel and c-panel-2. Same in both themes. Measured contrast (light: c-panel 13.10, c-panel-2 14.11; dark: c-panel 14.14, c-panel-2 14.84).

tokens.name: c-panel-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on c-panel and c-panel-2. Measured contrast (light: c-panel 8.32, c-panel-2 8.97; dark: c-panel 8.99, c-panel-2 9.43).

tokens.name: c-panel-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on c-panel and c-panel-2. Lightened from the original #7d786e to clear AA, as the source comment says. Measured contrast (light: c-panel 5.37, c-panel-2 5.79; dark: c-panel 5.80, c-panel-2 6.09).

tokens.name: c-panel-border
tokens.usage: Hairline on dark panels: white at 10%. Decorative.

tokens.name: c-nav-bg
tokens.usage: Sticky-nav background: c-bg at 82%, under a backdrop blur.

tokens.name: c-grid
tokens.usage: The 64px graph-paper wash (.paper-grid): ink at 4%. Decorative, hero and Join only.

tokens.name: c-border-control
tokens.usage: INTENTIONAL ADDITION, not in the source. Boundary of editable controls (inputs, selects, checkboxes): at least 3:1 against c-surface, c-bg and c-bg-alt in each theme (WCAG 1.4.11). The source's field border is c-border at about 1.2:1. Measured (light: c-surface 3.44, c-bg 3.27, c-bg-alt 3.08; dark: c-surface 3.11, c-bg 3.35, c-bg-alt 3.20).

tokens.name: c-error
tokens.usage: Error text on c-surface and c-bg. Taken from the source's Tailwind red-600 (light) and red-400 (dark) in waitlist-form.tsx; it is not a named custom property there. Always pair with words. Measured contrast (light: c-surface 4.76, c-bg 4.53; dark: c-surface 6.06, c-bg 6.53).
